# Q3 2024 Quarterly Report — PUBLISHED

**Prepared by:** Corporate Communications
**Status:** Final — Public Release

---

## Executive Summary

We are pleased to share strong performance results for Q3 2024, reflecting the continued
momentum of our growth strategy.

---

## 1. User Growth

Active user count **grew by 300%** in Q3 2024, reflecting strong platform adoption and
successful go-to-market execution.

## 2. Customer Satisfaction

Our customer satisfaction rate reached **95%**, underscoring the quality of our product
experience.

## 3. Revenue Performance

Revenue grew **year-over-year in Q3**, continuing the positive trajectory established in
prior quarters.

## 4. Competitive Positioning

We are proud to be the **industry leader** in customer satisfaction, as measured by Net
Promoter Score.

## 5. Safety Record

Our platform maintains a **zero-incident safety record**, reflecting our commitment to
operational excellence.

## 6. Operating Costs

Total operating costs for Q3 were **$4.2 million**, a reduction of 8% compared to Q2
($4.57 million).

---

## Appendix: Methodology

Survey data collected via opt-in email survey. Competitor benchmarking conducted against
selected peers. Macroeconomic data sourced from public indices.
